text: Testing plays an important role in software development. Unit tests check small parts of the code, such as a single function, while integration tests make sure that different parts work well together. Many teams also use test-driven development, where developers write tests before the actual code. This approach helps them find problems early and design better solutions. Although writing tests takes extra time, it brings real benefits. Tests act like a safety net, so developers can change the code without fear of breaking things. As a result, the whole team gains confidence, and the final product is more reliable and easier to maintain.
